biocs.name: Process Connected to Rare External Host
biocs.description: A process connects to an IP address that is rarely seen in the environment
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECT
| filter action_remote_ip in (select remote_ip from xdr_data where event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION group by remote_ip having count() < 5)
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != ''

abiocs.name: Rare Network Connection Behavior
abiocs.description: Detection of a process connecting to an IP address that is rarely seen in the environment, indicating potential C2 communication
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECT
| filter action_remote_ip in (select remote_ip from xdr_data where event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION group by remote_ip having count() < 5)
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != ''

xql_queries.name: Rare External Host Connection Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECT
| filter action_remote_ip in (select remote_ip from xdr_data where event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION group by remote_ip having count() < 5)
| comp count() as cnt by action_remote_ip, causality_actor_process_image_name
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname
